## What's Been Built

### McpGraph (experimental)

875+ line SKILL.md for directing graphs of MCP nodes [7]. Key finding:
Claude initially ignored the skill documentation despite similar
descriptions. "Added a server instruction telling the agent to read the
SKILL.md before using the tool. That one change caused Claude to reliably
read the skill first" [7].

### FastMCP 3.0

Added skills support using a "pull" model for resource updates [7].
The SEP-2640 repo uses a "push" model with subscriptions — both merit
evaluation [7].

### NimbleBrain

Consolidated separate components (server code, skills monorepo, registry
metadata) into single atomic repositories with skills as `skill://`
resources [7]. "Same or better results compared to the previous approach" [7].

### skillsovermcp.com

Live service converting any public GitHub repo with SKILL.md files into
an MCP server implementing SEP-2640 [14]. Exposes skills at
`skill://<name>/SKILL.md` with enumerable `skill://index.json` [14].
Provides backward-compatible tool-wrapper shim for clients that don't
support skill:// yet [14].

## What No Client Has Shipped

**No MCP client ships native skill:// resource support** as of May 2026.
The tool-wrapper shim on skillsovermcp.com exists specifically because
"not every MCP client speaks skill:// yet" [14].

Claude Code supports local skills and MCP Resources, but does not yet
treat skill:// resources as skills.

## Model Adherence Problems

The experimental findings report a critical limitation [7]:

> "Models do not reliably load or follow skill instructions, even when
> skills are preloaded."

Adherence is "time-decaying" — models follow instructions initially then
lose focus as context grows [7]. Weaker models show lower success rates [7].

**Workarounds discovered** [7]:
1. Server instructions explicitly directing the agent to read the skill
2. Subagent wrapping — placing skills in named subagents improved adherence
3. Explicit discovery in tool descriptions

## Maturity Assessment

| Aspect | Assessment |
|--------|------------|
| Format spec (Agent Skills) | **Mature** — adopted by 26+ platforms [15] |
| Transport spec (SEP-2640) | **Draft** — In Review, not accepted [13] |
| Server implementations | **Experimental** — 4+ implementations, 1 live service [8][14] |
| Client implementations | **None** — no native skill:// support shipped [14] |
| Model reliability | **Problematic** — time-decaying adherence [7] |

## Gaps and Limitations

- SEP-2640 may not be accepted into the MCP spec — it's still In Review
- No target date for acceptance or client adoption [13]
- Model adherence is the largest unsolved problem — the transport works,
  but models don't reliably follow the instructions once loaded [7]
- Plugin/bundle packaging explicitly out of scope [13]
- Registry integration (skills.json) is In Progress, not shipped [13]
